timeline.title: Eventotron Payment Based on Partnership Promise
timeline.event: Ben Carter paid £250 to Eventotron to implement a mirrored ticket system under assurance from Brighton Fringe (Alice Wright) that it would be welcomed and collaborative. This partnership framing was later used to delay brochure delivery and misrepresent intent.

timeline.title: New Venues and Shows Registered While Blocked
timeline.event: Despite Fringe's positioning of collapse, Half a Camel onboarded new acts and venues. Maris & Otter joined, Alec Crane registered, and infrastructure remained live while brochure progress was covertly stalled.

timeline.title: Brochure Erased Then Used as Defamation Trigger
timeline.event: Brighton Fringe accused Ben Carter of failing to produce a brochure. The design was ready, but print was delayed by conflicting guidance around ticketing, logo use, and platform visibility — a suppression then weaponised.
